In the Caribbean and Latin America, a practical **upper-upscale conversion shortlist** usually includes the following:

| Hotel company | Brands commonly evaluated | Typical conversion fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**; also **Sheraton**, **Westin**, and **Delta Hotels** | Autograph and Tribute are often first choices for distinctive independent hotels because they preserve more property identity. Marriott specifically positions its collection brands for independent-hotel affiliations and operates Autograph in the region’s all-inclusive segment. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**, **DoubleTree by Hilton** | Curio is especially relevant for boutique, historic, and resort conversions; Hilton and DoubleTree fit more standardized full-service assets. Conversions represented nearly 30% of Hilton’s 2024 CALA signings, with Curio conversions appearing throughout the Caribbean and Latin America. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-wraps-2024-with-record-portfolio-and-pipeline-growth-in-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, sometimes **Destination by Hyatt** | Unbound is Hyatt’s principal independent-hotel option and explicitly spans upper-upscale and luxury. Hyatt Regency suits larger convention or resort properties, while Hyatt Centric works for lifestyle-oriented urban and leisure locations. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | **voco**, **Crowne Plaza**, **Hotel Indigo** | voco is particularly conversion-oriented, with flexible standards and a comparatively fast reflagging model. Crowne Plaza is considered for business-oriented full-service hotels; Hotel Indigo for locally themed lifestyle assets. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/100-open-hotels-for-ihgs-fastest-growing-premium-brand-voco?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Collection**, **Pullman**, **Mövenpick**, **Swissôtel** | MGallery is the most natural soft-brand conversion candidate; Accor specifically classifies it as upper-upscale and prioritizes conversions for its collection brands. Pullman is frequently considered for larger urban and resort assets. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Wyndham Grand** | Registry is an upper-upscale soft brand with substantial relevance to all-inclusive and resort properties; Wyndham Grand is the corresponding hard-brand option. Both already have recognizable Caribbean and Mexican resort examples. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels / Radisson Americas** | **Radisson Individuals**, **Radisson Blu**, sometimes **Radisson Collection** | Radisson Individuals is an upper-upscale soft brand designed for independent conversions. Radisson Blu offers a more standardized upper-upscale flag for major urban and resort markets. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/our-brands/upper-upscale/radisson-blu?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Minor Hotels** | **NH Collection**, **Tivoli Hotels & Resorts** | Particularly relevant in Latin American urban markets where NH already has operating infrastructure and recognition. NH Collection is explicitly positioned in the upper-upscale tier. ([media.minorhotels.com](https://media.minorhotels.com/en-GLO/248205-minor-hotels-to-debut-in-paraguay-with-nh-collection-asuncion/?utm_source=openai)) |

### Brands most likely to make an initial shortlist

For a typical independent upper-upscale hotel, the most frequently logical starting points are:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Curio Collection by Hilton**
3. **Tribute Portfolio**
4. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
5. **voco**
6. **MGallery**
7. **Registry Collection Hotels**
8. **Radisson Individuals**

These “collection” or conversion-oriented brands generally provide more flexibility around architecture, room configuration, food and beverage, and existing property identity than traditional hard brands.

For a **large standardized city hotel or convention property**, the shortlist shifts toward **Hilton, Sheraton, Westin, Hyatt Regency, Crowne Plaza, Pullman, Wyndham Grand, and Radisson Blu**.

For an **all-inclusive Caribbean or Mexican resort**, the most relevant options often include **Autograph Collection All-Inclusive, Curio Collection, Registry Collection**, and—depending on positioning—Hyatt’s **Dreams, Secrets, or other Inclusive Collection brands**. Exact chain-scale classification can vary by market and benchmarking provider.
